annotations.title: Records to keep (and who keeps them)

description: The records the regulations expect for the prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements (26 CFR 1.45-12), as a checklist for a taxpayer, a prime contractor or a subcontractor, with how they may be kept (each company keeps its own unredacted records, or hands PII-redacted copies to the taxpayer or a vendor; unredacted records go to the IRS on request) and how they feed Form 7220.

role.description: Whose checklist (default taxpayer: the credit claimant).
